data.indexCnDesc: 中证农业主题指数选取50只业务涉及农产品、农用机械、化肥与农药、畜禽药物等领域的上市公司证券作为指数样本，以反映农业主题上市公司证券的整体表现。
data.indexEnDesc: CSI Agriculture Thematic Index selects 50 listed firms whose business involves the agriculture products, farm machinery, fertilizers, agricultural chemicals, and livestock drugs as constituents. The index is to measure the performance of the agricultural theme securities.
